prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Moving sign-in post-adoption (+13.3%, underpredicted) or post-certificate (+5.8%, overpredicted) and multi-device account sync banners (+2.7%, overpredicted) were helpful, while post-waiting room sign-in hurt (-3.9%) and other sync hints showed no clear effect.
Path clarity headline updates (+5.9%, underpredicted) and path selection spotlight layouts (+2.7%, underpredicted) were helpful; copy simplifications, value refreshes, time expectation banners, and showcase layouts showed no clear effect.
Interactive waiting rooms (+5.6%, overpredicted), background readiness status (+3.3%, underpredicted), and desktop visibility status checks (+4.7%, underpredicted) were helpful, whereas 3D trackers, completion timer displays, sound notifications, and spawn alerts showed no clear effect.
Photo quality guides with companion previews (+7.6%, overpredicted) and split upload companion preview layouts (+8.1%, underpredicted) were helpful; compact grid layouts (-7.7%), photo fallback flows (-11.8%), custom photo guidelines banners (-5.0%), and mascot stamp redesigns (-24.1%) made results worse.
System tray location notification tips (+3.8%, overpredicted) were helpful, while direct controls guides (-14.4%) and first interaction tips (-6.5%) made results worse; mascot welcome stages, interaction badges, tray controls tips, and docking hints showed no clear effect.

Changes:
0: [finish, redesign] Interactive Desktop Companion Stage Layout: Redesigns the final home intro screen into a stage layout featuring an animated pet spawn preview and desktop tray control callout. (why: Finish step has a 70.1% conversion rate and users report pet visibility issues and confusion controlling the desktop pet after onboarding.)
1: [choose_path, new_screen] Interactive Path Discovery Screen: Introduces a new path intro screen prior to path selection that clearly contrasts ready-made companions with custom photo creation. (why: 19.6% of users drop off at the initial path decision screen with a long mean duration of 514s.)
2: [choose_path, redesign] Story Stage Visual Redesign: Redesigns the story intro screen into a full stage layout centered around an animated welcome mascot visual. (why: Initial story and choose path drop-off is high (80.4% conversion) and needs stronger visual hook engagement.)
3: [sign_in, copy] Existing Pet Account Recovery Copy: Updates headline and copy on the sign-in screen reassuring returning users that signing in restores and protects existing pet progress. (why: 8 support emails mentioned missing or reset pets after signing in again.)
4: [home, hint] Desktop Spawn Location Hint: Displays an explicit hint on the waiting screen explaining exactly where on the monitor screen the pet will spawn. (why: 3 support emails reported pets not showing on the desktop or users being unable to locate them.)
5: [home, wait_info] Background Pet Hatching Status Bar: Replaces waiting status with detailed live background asset generation progress updates and notification toggles. (why: Home waiting screen median time is 201s (mean 2336s) causing drop-off prior to completion.)
6: [adoption, incentive] Starter Desktop Pet Name Badge: Displays a celebratory starter pet badge with customized pet name confirmation on the adoption certificate screen. (why: Adoption conversion drops significantly to 68.9% (1017s mean time); rewarding completion reinforces commitment.)
7: [finish, notification] System Tray Control Shortcut Tip: Displays a delayed tip notification after onboarding finishes showing the exact system tray icon and desktop toggle shortcuts. (why: 3 support emails expressed confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after onboarding.)
8: [adoption, layout] Split Spotlight Friend Selection Layout: Updates the pick_friend screen to a split layout showcasing live pet animation previews side-by-side with companion traits. (why: Adoption step has the highest funnel drop-off (68.9% conversion) and long selection times (median 89s).)
